veranderings.voor: en sit later op jou kos
veranderings.na: en gaan sit later op jou kos
veranderings.rede: 'gaan sit' is the natural Afrikaans for a fly landing somewhere and avoids the flat repetition of 'sit ... sit'.

veranderings.blok: Dinge wat jy elke dag kan doen
veranderings.rede: Under the project's AWS rule the first half is a command with no stated subject, so no comma goes before 'want'.
A noun is better defined by a noun phrase than by a 'wanneer' clause.

vlae.rede: The block heading says 'Boomplantdag' (one day), but the text says it is now a whole week (Nasionale Boomplantweek). A heading cannot be changed by the language step; the writer may want to check that the heading and text match.
